children.text: Park City Place, formerly the Holiday Inn, is located in downtown Bridgeport. This property features 97 beautifully renovated apartments just moments away from the Metro-North train station, the bus terminal, and the Port Jefferson Ferry, making daily commutes effortless.

styles.fontFamily: stevie-sans, proxima-nova, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

children.text: While the units were recently renovated for market-rate rents, in partnership with the Department of Housing, they are now being converted into affordable housing. Upon arrival, you will be welcomed by a beautifully designed lobby. Each apartment features an open-concept living room connected to an eat-in kitchen, complete with granite countertops and top-of-the-line stainless-steel appliances. Additionally, all units are equipped with central air conditioning.

children.text: These apartments will be available in Downtown Bridgeport for households earning at or below 80% of the Area Median Income. The breakdown includes 51 one-bedroom units and 46 two-bedroom units. include a combined laundry and lounge area, a fitness center, and controlled access. Park City Place offers a convenient lifestyle for those seeking the best of urban living in Bridgeport. A parking garage is also available for residents at a monthly charge.

children.text: Choose from our apartments in Boston, Massachusetts, and have it all. From a spacious layout, light-filled rooms, and convenient features and amenities, simply everything you need is right here at 71 Westland Apartments. Our prime location in Boston puts you in proximity to the best of everything in the area. With a near-perfect neighborhood like this, you’ll be mere moments from restaurants, shopping, major employers, and great schools.
